query: 物种多样性保护 物种多样性保护 衡量企业对关键物种与生物多样性保护的体系化管理。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：披露了受影响的 IUCN 红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单，设定了明确的种群保护/恢复量化目标，建立了长效监测指标（如物种丰富度、丰度），并与学术机构或 NGO 建立了长期合作机制。 • 1分（合格）：识别了运营区域的敏感物种，有定性的保护措施描述（如避开繁殖期、设置禁猎牌），但缺乏量化的保护目标或系统的长期监测数据。 • 0分（不合格）：无物种保护相关披露，或仅有笼统的“关爱动植物”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：保护机制覆盖 >80% 已识别的生物多样性重点区域、高敏感项目或受影响物种栖息地。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对明星物种（如大熊猫）进行保护而忽略其他受威胁物种，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关信息。 物种保护 敏感物种 受影响物种 国家重点保护物种 IUCN红色名录 受威胁物种 特有种 栖息地保护 繁殖期避让 物种丰富度 物种丰度 生物多样性行动计划 生物多样性监测 环境DNA 红外相机 species conservation sensitive species affected species protected species IUCN Red List threatened species endemic species habitat protection breeding season avoidance species richness species abundance biodiversity action plan BAP biodiversity monitoring environmental DNA eDNA camera traps 是否披露受影响的IUCN红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单？ 是否设定种群保护/恢复量化目标？ 有哪些长期监测指标（如丰富度、丰度）？ 采取了哪些保护措施？ 是否与科研机构或NGO长期合作？ 机制覆盖哪些重点区域或栖息地？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '物种多样性保护'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否披露受影响的IUCN红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单？ 是否设定种群保护/恢复量化目标？ 有哪些长期监测指标（如丰富度、丰度）？ 采取了哪些保护措施？ 是否与科研机构或NGO长期合作？ 机制覆盖哪些重点区域或栖息地？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“关爱动植物”；仅有办公室绿植或园区绿化；仅有一般土地复垦而无物种管理；仅有捐赠野生动物基金而无运营影响管理；区分：本指标聚焦关键物种与生物多样性的识别、目标、监测与保护机制；一般环境政策或绿化美化不能替代物种保护体系披露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: As a leading and influential property developer in China, the Group understands the importance of developing sustainable buildings to create maximum value for stakeholders. Therefore, the Group adopts a comprehensive approach to integrate sustainable development throughout the life cycle of its properties. The Group has an explicit green procurement policy in its 'Environmental Policy', which gives priority to products and services that promote environmental sustainability, and uses international standards such as ISO14001 environmental management system certification as the standard for assessing suppliers' environmental performance. To manage social and environmental risks in the supply chain, the Group conducts regular performance assessments and two-way assessments to ensure that issues are summarized and addressed in a timely manner.

[Content]
As a leading and influential property developer in China, the Group understands the importance of developing sustainable buildings to create maximum value for stakeholders. Therefore, the Group adopts a comprehensive approach to integrate sustainable development throughout the life cycle of its properties. The Group has an explicit green procurement policy in its 'Environmental Policy', which gives priority to products and services that promote environmental sustainability, and uses international standards such as ISO14001 environmental management system certification as the standard for assessing suppliers' environmental performance. To manage social and environmental risks in the supply chain, the Group conducts regular performance assessments and two-way assessments to ensure that issues are summarized and addressed in a timely manner.

results.text: The '14 th Five-Year Plan for Building Energy Conservation and Green Building Development' issued by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development sets development goals for the nation's construction industry. By 2025, all new buildings in urban areas will be fully constructed as green building. More than 50 million square meters of ultra-low energy and near-zero energy buildings will be built. Prefabricated buildings shall account for 30% of new urban buildings of the year. The installed capacity of solar photovoltaics in new buildings will be more than 50 million kilowatts. The application area of geothermal buildings will be more than 100 million square meters, and the replacement rate of renewable energy in urban buildings will reach 8%. The proportion of electricity consumption in building energy consumption is more than 55%. With these goals, a green, low-carbon, and circular construction and development mode will be formed, and a solid foundation will be laid for carbon peaking in urban and rural construction by 2030.
